# Results Format

## Cash vs. Credit

| Site          | Displayed Price                   | Conversion           |
| ------------- | --------------------------------- | -------------------- |
| GameNerdz     | Store Credit (25% bonus included) | Cash = Credit ÷ 1.25 |
| CoolStuffInc  | Both Cash and Credit shown        | Credit = Cash × 1.25 |
| PriceCharting | Market price (not a buylist offer) | N/A                 |

Example: $218.95 credit ÷ 1.25 = $175.16 cash.

## Comparison Table

Compile all items into one table. **Follow this format exactly:**

| Item Name | Offer Value | PriceCharting (Ungraded) | CoolStuffInc (Cash) | CoolStuffInc (Credit) | GameNerdz (Cash) | GameNerdz (Credit) | Best Alternative |
| --------- | ----------- | ------------------------ | ------------------- | --------------------- | ---------------- | ------------------ | ---------------- |
| Item 1    | $XX.XX      | $XX.XX (+X%)             | $XX.XX (+X%)        | $XX.XX (+X%)          | $XX.XX (+X%)     | $XX.XX (+X%)       | $XX.XX (+X%)     |
| Item 2    | $XX.XX      | $XX.XX (-X%)             | $XX.XX (-X%)        | $XX.XX (-X%)          | $XX.XX (-X%)     | $XX.XX (-X%)       | $XX.XX (-X%)     |

**Example:**

| Item Name            | Offer Value | PriceCharting (Ungraded) | CoolStuffInc (Cash) | CoolStuffInc (Credit) | GameNerdz (Cash) | GameNerdz (Credit) | Best Alternative |
| -------------------- | ----------- | ------------------------ | ------------------- | --------------------- | ---------------- | ------------------ | ---------------- |
| Charizard ex 223/197 | $150.00     | $180.00 (+20%)           | $140.00 (-7%)       | $175.00 (+17%)        | $136.00 (-9%)    | $170.00 (+13%)     | $180.00 (+20%)   |

## Column Notes

- **Percentages** show the difference from the Offer Value. Positive (+) = the site value is higher than the offer; negative (−) = lower.
- **Best Alternative** shows the highest value found and the amount you'd gain or lose by accepting the offer instead.
- If no offer value was given by the user, omit the Offer Value column and the percentages.
